title: Talk to Ceres instead

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: He once sent me there to pick up some work files he forgot. The key code obviously changed all the time...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He once sent me there to pick up some work files he forgot. The key code obviously changed all the time...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did Gan ever talk about his work at LifeCorp?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did Gan ever talk about his work at LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did Gan ever talk about his work at LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did Gan ever talk about his work at LifeCorp?

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: If he did, and I tell you, will you leave me in peace? At least for a while?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If he did, and I tell you, will you leave me in peace? At least for a while?

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: And his technicians always forgot the current key.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And his technicians always forgot the current key.

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: He set the code to automatically change every day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He set the code to automatically change every day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did Gan ever mention a key code for accessing service rooms for The Old Network?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did Gan ever mention a key code for accessing service rooms for The Old Network?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did Gan ever mention a key code for accessing service rooms for The Old Network?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did Gan ever mention a key code for accessing service rooms for The Old Network?

nodes.speaker: Ceres Coilson
nodes.text: Sometimes. It wasn't as secret as you might think. A bunch of tech nerds having a big tech party every day in his department.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes. It wasn't as secret as you might think. A bunch of tech nerds having a big tech party every day in his department.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The last time, I promise. If you can tell me what I need to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The last time, I promise. If you can tell me what I need to know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The last time, I promise. If you can tell me what I need to know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The last time, I promise. If you can tell me what I need to know.
